doc: MiniCPM3 (OpenBMB), the NATIVE transformers 5 class: DeepSeek-V2's multi-head latent attention with the plain cos/sin rotation (rope_interleave false), a dense gated MLP in every layer and the muP scalings - the embedding times scale_emb, each residual branch times scale_depth/sqrt(num_hidden_layers). the head input is divided by hidden_size/dim_model_base (config.logits_scaling). The built-in refusal of this architecture is by name, so the harness reads it under a renamed architecture (FR-25). Third-party adapter (lane H): data only, extends the built-in deepseek-v3.
